inputs.text: [excited] TIE… tan… oh… SOR. [curious] In Greek, "Titan" was the giant, the biggest one of all.
[amazed] That's the one. And not just any giant: [proud] the biggest animal that ever walked on Earth. [calm] It lived in Argentina, a hundred million years ago.
[confident] Scientists have never found a single bite mark on its adult bones. [serious] Its size alone kept it safe.
